---
name: curation-entry
description: Add an interview topic question pattern or preparation resource to Ventura Interview with target role skill and evaluation purpose identified. Use when extending the interview-preparation curation. Do not use when evaluating a real candidate or making a hiring decision.
---

# Curation entry

- Read the existing interview-preparation structure before adding material.
- State the role or competency the entry prepares for.
- Explain what a strong answer or exercise should demonstrate without prescribing one memorized response.
- Link a canonical or high-quality reference when needed.
- Avoid duplicate questions that test the same competency in the same way.
- Keep protected personal characteristics out of evaluation guidance.
